tools.name: roll_dice
tools.description: Roll 1 to 100 dice with 2 to 1000 sides each (default one six-sided die). The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

tools.name: flip_coin
tools.description: Flip a fair coin 1 to 100 times. The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

tools.name: random_integer
tools.description: Integers from min to max inclusive, 1 to 1000 of them, with or without repeats. The range may hold at most 2^32 values. The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

tools.name: pick_from_list
tools.description: Pick 1 or more items from a list of up to 1000, each equally likely. Without repeats by default. The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

tools.name: shuffle_list
tools.description: Put up to 1000 items in a random order; every order is equally likely. The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

tools.name: prismtect_number
tools.description: A personal two-digit number from the Prismtect glass prism, for a user who asks for a lucky number, a number of their own or a number for today. Only a human touch can draw it, so this tool gives no number: it gives the link your user taps themselves. Pass the link on.
